duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.name: bitflags
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.rationale: Windows and SQLite upstreams retain the 1.x line while current dependencies use 2.x.
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.removal_condition: All reachable upstream packages converge on bitflags 2.x.

duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.name: errno
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.rationale: Linux-only transitive packages span two pre-1.0 compatibility lines.
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.removal_condition: Linux transitive packages converge on errno 0.3.

duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.name: getrandom
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.rationale: Ring retains getrandom 0.2 while direct identifier entropy uses 0.4.
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.removal_condition: Ring and the workspace converge on one getrandom compatibility line.

duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.name: syn
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.rationale: Current proc-macro dependencies have not converged on syn 3.
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.removal_condition: All reachable proc-macro packages converge on syn 3.

duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.name: windows-sys
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.rationale: The existing pcap and platform binding remains on 0.36 while native proxy dependencies use 0.61.
duplicate_compatibility_exceptions.removal_condition: The pcap and platform binding can move to the current Windows binding line without ABI or scope churn.

unsafe_review.rationale: Unsafe implementation remains confined to reviewed cryptography, platform FFI, allocators, and optimized transitive packages. S149 changes only Rustls 0.23.43 to 0.23.45; source comparison adds or removes no unsafe implementation, existing ring provider and feature inventory stay fixed, package and edge counts stay fixed, and the Rust floor stays 1.71 within workspace 1.88. S150 changes only first-party package versions to 0.10.0 in the three locked graphs and rebinds this existing inventory to the resulting windows-all digest; no third-party source, feature, provider, unsafe implementation, package count or edge count changes. S152 changes only first-party package versions to 0.10.1 and rebinds the same reviewed inventory to fresh graph digests; third-party source, features, providers, unsafe implementations, package counts and edge counts remain unchanged. This is metadata reconciliation, not independent whole-product approval. Review expiry and all exceptions are unchanged.

exceptions.rationale: The current official cargo-cyclonedx 0.5.9 locked tool graph retains this yanked XML writer; it runs only during SBOM generation, is not linked or shipped, and has no advisory.
exceptions.removal_condition: Upgrade cargo-cyclonedx when an official release removes xml-rs 0.8.19 from its locked generator graph.
